description: P3 coupling. The overlord consumer pins the overlord's own trunk-safety sentence — `Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch; never push without first confirming the current branch is not trunk.` — the claim-carrying clause of THIS rule at the consumer site. Its first clause deliberately coincides with this fixture's source pattern in safety-rails.md: that is the same rule correctly witnessed at two sites, not a foreign-pattern paste — do not 'fix' the coincidence by widening one side. Honest guarantee: deleting the trunk-commit prohibition from either file turns the suite red; a rewrite-around or meaning inversion that keeps these bytes intact is outside what a presence pin can see. The molt consumer pins its operative no-trunk preflight step — `Confirm current branch is not `trunk`` — the normative clause that enforces this rule at commit time, not the `trunk` input's parameter description, which merely defines what the input means and can stay intact after the preflight is deleted. Every molt commit runs through `plugin/skills/molt/scripts/molt.sh`, so two consumers in that script pin the check that enforces this rule at commit time: the `refuse_trunk_branch` function, one span carrying both trunk tests (trunk names the current branch as text, and a ref that trunk names resolves to the current branch), the blocker `the current branch is trunk` for each, and the stops when the comparison or the trunk read fails; and its call site, one span carrying the current branch name gate followed by the `refuse_trunk_branch` call. Deleting either test, either trunk blocker, or the call turns the suite red. Three runner scripts also refuse a current branch that a remote names as its default branch through `refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD`, whatever trunk or base names: `plugin/skills/molt/scripts/molt.sh` before it commits, `plugin/skills/push-branch/scripts/push-branch.sh` before it pushes, and `plugin/skills/create-working-branch/scripts/create-working-branch.sh` before it creates or confirms the working branch. In each script one consumer pins the `refuse_remote_default_branch` function as one span: the `hivemind_branch_is_remote_default` call on the current branch, the blocker for its default-branch result, code 1 (`the current branch is trunk`, `$mismatch_reason` and `working_branch equals trunk` respectively), and the stops when git cannot read a remote HEAD or the compare fails. A second consumer pins its call site: in molt.sh and create-working-branch.sh directly after the existing trunk refusal call, and in push-branch.sh directly after the function's own closing brace. Deleting the shared-function call, the code-1 blocker, either stop, or the call site turns the suite red. Residuals, stated plainly: the pins do not prove that each call runs before the staging, commit, push or branch-create lines, nor what the shared `hivemind_ref_names_branch`, `hivemind_resolve_name_refs` and `hivemind_branch_is_remote_default` helpers in `plugin/skills/_shared/git-refusals.sh` compute; that behavior is asserted by `tools/test_molt.sh`, `tools/test_push_branch.sh` and `tools/test_create_working_branch.sh`.

source.pattern: Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch

consumers.pattern: Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch; never push without first confirming the current branch is not trunk.

refuse_trunk_branch() { local name_rc=0 trunk_rc=0 hivemind_ref_names_branch "$trunk_name" "$branch_name" || name_rc=$? case "$name_rc" in 0) blocker "the current branch is trunk" ;; 1) ;; *) blocker "cannot compare the current branch with trunk" ;; esac hivemind_resolve_name_refs "$trunk_name" "$branch_name" || trunk_rc=$? case "$trunk_rc" in 0) ;; 1) blocker "the current branch is trunk" ;; 3) blocker "cannot compare the current branch with trunk" ;; *) blocker "cannot read trunk" ;; esac }
hivemind_assert_identifier "$branch_name" || blocker "the current branch name contains characters outside the safe allowlist" refuse_trunk_branch

refuse_remote_default_branch() { local default_rc=0 hivemind_branch_is_remote_default "$branch_name" || default_rc=$? case "$default_rc" in 0) ;; 1) blocker "the current branch is trunk" ;; 2) blocker "cannot read trunk" ;; *) blocker "cannot compare the current branch with trunk" ;; esac }

refuse_remote_default_branch() { local default_rc=0 hivemind_branch_is_remote_default "$current_branch" || default_rc=$? case "$default_rc" in 0) ;; 1) blocker "$mismatch_reason" ;; 2) blocker "cannot read base" ;; *) blocker "cannot compare the current branch with base" ;; esac }

refuse_remote_default_branch() { local default_rc=0 hivemind_branch_is_remote_default "$branch_name" || default_rc=$? case "$default_rc" in 0) ;; 1) blocker "working_branch equals trunk" ;; 3) blocker "cannot compare working_branch with trunk" ;; *) blocker "cannot read trunk" ;; esac }
